queries.name: documents
queries.sql:
WITH d AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='OINV')
WHERE doc_date>='2026-09-01' AND doc_date<'2026-10-01'),
lt AS (SELECT l.source_system,l.doc_entry,COUNT(*) lines,
COUNT(DISTINCT l.line_num) distinct_lines,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE l.line_total IS NULL) missing_line_amounts,
SUM(CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) line_amount,
COUNT(DISTINCT x.product_business_type) categories,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE x."ItemCode" IS NULL) unclassified,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE x.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'VALIDATED') nonvalidated,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.currency IS DISTINCT FROM l.currency) currency_mismatches,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.raw_extraction_id IS DISTINCT FROM l.raw_extraction_id
 OR d.source_as_of IS DISTINCT FROM l.source_as_of) lineage_mismatches
FROM d JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='INV1') l ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry
LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') x ON x."ItemCode"=l.item_code GROUP BY 1,2),
t AS (SELECT d.*,CAST(d.doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6)) header_amount,
COALESCE(lt.lines,0) lines,lt.distinct_lines,lt.missing_line_amounts,lt.line_amount,lt.categories,
lt.unclassified,lt.nonvalidated,lt.currency_mismatches,lt.lineage_mismatches,
CAST(d.doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))-lt.line_amount delta
FROM d LEFT JOIN lt ON d.source_system=lt.source_system AND d.doc_entry=lt.doc_entry),
a AS (SELECT *,ABS(delta) abs_delta,
100*ABS(delta)/NULLIF(ABS(header_amount),0) abs_percent_of_header FROM t WHERE canceled='N') SELECT doc_entry,doc_num,SUBSTR(doc_date,1,10) doc_date,currency,
header_amount A,line_amount B,lines,categories,raw_extraction_id,source_as_of,
currency_mismatches,lineage_mismatches,missing_line_amounts FROM a ORDER BY doc_entry

queries.name: lines_for_parity
queries.sql:
SELECT l.doc_entry,l.line_num,l.line_total,l.quantity,l.price,l.currency,
l.raw_extraction_id,x.product_business_type,x.status FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='OINV') d JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='INV1') l
ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') x ON x."ItemCode"=l.item_code
WHERE d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>='2026-09-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-10-01'
